about.metaTitle: About — building the home of food creators
about.metaDescription: FOODSbyme is building the home of independent food creators: the tools, payments and delivery that let people who cook build audiences and businesses.
about.title: We’re building the home of *independent food creators.*
about.intro: Not another delivery app. A home where food creators build audiences, earn income and grow communities, wherever they cook.
about.belief: Food is the most universal culture there is. The people who make it should be able to build audiences and businesses around it, the way creators do everywhere else.
about.beliefBody: For most of the last decade, food apps treated cooking as a commodity. A restaurant uploaded a menu, a customer tapped a button, a rider carried a bag, and the person who actually made the food stayed invisible. We think that’s backwards. The most talented cooks aren’t interchangeable. They have a hand, a story and a signature. FOODS is built on a simple idea: food is creator content, and creators deserve infrastructure.
about.pillarsIntro: FOODS only works when all four reinforce each other.

pillars.title: Creators
pillars.body: Cooks, bakers, pastry chefs and food entrepreneurs who build audiences and earn from their craft.

pillars.title: Communities
pillars.body: The followers, regulars and gift-givers who turn a kitchen into a movement.

pillars.title: Fleet partners
pillars.body: The partner-owned bikes and fleets that move every meal the platform makes.

pillars.title: Infrastructure
pillars.body: The technology, payments, logistics and APIs that make all of it run, quietly and reliably.

values.title: Creators first
values.body: The person who makes the food is the point. Every decision starts with whether it helps a creator build something real.

values.title: Food is culture
values.body: We treat every food tradition as the living culture it is, not a commodity flattened into a faceless menu.

values.title: Wealth, not gigs
values.body: We build models that let people own and grow, creators and fleet partners alike, instead of extracting from them.

values.title: Local everywhere
values.body: A kitchen in Lagos, Lisbon or Osaka gets the same tools, in its own language and its own currency.

about.visionTitle: Food creators everywhere, earning what they’re worth.
about.visionBody1: We imagine a Sunday cook who becomes a household name in their city. A baker who funds a storefront from her following. A single bike that grows into a fleet that employs a neighbourhood.
about.visionBody2: The creator economy reshaped music, writing and video. We’re bringing it to the table, and building the infrastructure so the value flows to the people who make and move the food.
about.ctaTitle: Come build the future of food with us.
about.ctaBody: Whether you cook, deliver, invest or just love good food, there’s a place for you here.

howItWorks.metaTitle: How FOODS works — from craving to community
howItWorks.metaDescription: Discover creators, follow their kitchens, crave what they cook, order experiences and join communities. Here is how FOODS works, end to end.
howItWorks.title: From a craving to a *community*, in five moves.
howItWorks.intro: FOODS is not another delivery app. It’s where food creators build audiences, earn income and grow communities, and where you get to taste the result.
howItWorks.journeyIntro: Every great food relationship on FOODS follows the same arc. Here’s what it feels like.

steps.title: Discover creators
steps.body: Open FOODS and meet the cooks, bakers and chefs near you. Browse by craving, neighbourhood or what’s trending in your city. Every kitchen has a face, a story and a signature.

steps.title: Follow the kitchens you love
steps.body: Follow a creator and their kitchen becomes part of your feed. See what’s cooking today, what drops this weekend, and the dishes their community can’t stop ordering.

steps.title: Crave what they make next
steps.body: Creators post the food they’re making, not a static catalogue. A craving turns into a tap. Save dishes, set reminders for weekly menus, and never miss a holiday box again.

steps.title: Order experiences, not just meals
steps.body: Order a single dish, reserve a weekly menu, book a private dining experience, buy a course or grab a digital product. Checkout is fast, secure and built around the creator.

steps.title: Join the community
steps.body: Every creator has a community. Gift meals to people you love, support a creator you believe in, and watch a kitchen grow because of the people who showed up for it.

discovery.title: Plan your week

faqs.a: Delivery is part of it, but FOODS is a creator platform first. You follow the people who make the food, see what they’re cooking, and order from a relationship rather than a faceless menu. Delivery is handled by partner-owned fleets.

faqs.q: How is this different from ordering from a restaurant?
faqs.a: Restaurants upload a fixed menu. Creators post what they’re making, drop weekly menus, run courses, sell products and host private dining. You’re following a person and their craft, not browsing a catalogue.
Single dishes, reservable weekly menus, private chef experiences, catering, cooking courses, and digital products like recipe guides and spice blends, all from the same creator profile.
FOODS is available worldwide on iOS and Android, in 23 languages. Open the app to see the kitchens near you.

faqs.q: How do I become a creator or fleet partner?
faqs.a: Creators can open a kitchen straight from the app. Fleet partners apply through a short five-step form on our Fleet partners page. Both take minutes to start.

faqs.a: Creators are verified, held to the food-safety rules that apply where they cook, and rated by their community. Secure payment and a clear dispute process protect every order.

forCreators.startTitle: From first post to full-time, *step by step*

start.title: Open your kitchen
start.body: Download FOODS, set up your profile and tell your story. It takes minutes, with no website or storefront to build.

start.title: Post what you cook
start.body: Share dishes, drop your first weekly menu, and let people follow along. Consistency builds the following.

start.title: Get discovered
start.body: Your kitchen surfaces to nearby cravings. Followers turn into regulars, and regulars into a community.

start.title: Grow your income
start.body: Layer on courses, products, catering and private dining. Turn a passion into revenue that compounds.

faqs.q: Do I need a restaurant or commercial kitchen?
faqs.a: No. Most FOODS creators start from a home kitchen. Food rules differ from country to country, so onboarding walks you through what applies where you cook.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to start?
faqs.a: Opening a kitchen is free. FOODS earns a transparent service fee on orders. There are no upfront costs, no subscription and no charge to publish menus, courses or products.

faqs.q: How and when do I get paid?
faqs.a: Earnings accrue per order and settle to your registered account on a regular cycle, in the currency you sell in. Your dashboard shows pending and paid balances in real time, with a full breakdown per order.
Absolutely. Many creators start with a single weekly menu on Sundays and grow from there. You control your menu, your capacity and your schedule.
Onboarding help, food-safety guidance, creator analytics, marketing tools and a support team that responds. As you grow, you unlock courses, catering and private dining.
Partner-owned fleets. You focus on the food; order assignment, tracking and delivery are handled by the platform and our fleet partners.

forCreators.ctaTitle: Your kitchen is your business. Start it today.
forCreators.ctaBody: Opening a kitchen is free and takes minutes. Build a following, earn real income and grow a community around your food.

communities.metaTitle: Communities — food that brings people together
communities.metaDescription: On FOODS, every creator has a community. Gift meals, support kitchens you believe in, celebrate together and turn food into belonging.
communities.title: Food is how we *belong.*
communities.intro: Behind every kitchen on FOODS is a community of people who show up: ordering, gifting and celebrating together. This is where food becomes more than a meal.
communities.pillarsIntro: The creator economy is built on community. For food, that community is the difference between a one-off order and a kitchen people love.

pillars.title: Community gifting
pillars.body: Send a meal to someone you love, or to someone who needs one. Gifting turns a single order into an act of care, and grows the creator’s reach.

pillars.title: Creator communities
pillars.body: Every kitchen has a community of regulars, super-fans and first-timers. Follow, comment and belong to the kitchens you love.

pillars.title: Support that compounds
pillars.body: When you back a creator, you’re backing a small business. Repeat orders and gifts are how a Sunday hobby becomes a full-time income.

pillars.title: Celebrate the moments
pillars.body: Birthdays, holidays, new babies and ordinary Tuesdays. Food is how we mark life, and FOODS makes it shareable.

communities.giftTitle: Give a meal. Grow a kitchen. Both at once.
communities.giftBody: Gifting is the most generous thing you can do on FOODS, and the most powerful way to help a creator grow. Every gift feeds someone and introduces a kitchen to a new face.

ways.title: Gift a single meal
ways.body: Pick a dish, add a note, and send it to a friend, a relative, or someone having a hard week.

ways.title: Fund a community drop
ways.body: Pool with others to sponsor a creator’s community meal for a neighbourhood, workplace or cause.

ways.title: Show up in the comments
ways.body: Reactions, reviews and shout-outs. The smallest support tells a creator their work matters.

ways.title: Spread the word
ways.body: Share a creator’s profile, dish or menu with a beautiful preview card. Discovery is the best gift.

faqs.a: You can buy a meal and send it to someone else, a friend, a relative or someone in need, directly through the app. The recipient gets the food; the creator gets a new customer and wider reach.

faqs.q: Can businesses or groups gift at scale?
faqs.a: Yes. Workplaces, faith groups, associations and organisations can fund community drops, sponsoring meals from a creator for a group or a cause. Get in touch and we’ll help you set it up.
Communities are how creators grow. Gifts introduce a kitchen to new people, repeat support builds reliable income, and engaged followers turn a hobby into a business.

faqs.q: Is gifting available everywhere FOODS is?
faqs.a: Yes. Gifting works wherever FOODS does. Open the app to see the kitchens near the person you’re gifting.

communities.ctaTitle: Be the reason a kitchen grows.

Earnings accrue per delivered order and are settled to your registered account on a regular cycle, in your local currency. Your dashboard shows pending and paid settlement in real time.
Yes. Most partners start small and scale. Once you’ve proven reliability, you can add riders and bikes, unlock more order volume, and eventually a defined territory.

items.q: How do I create an account?
items.a: Download the FOODSbyme app, tap Get started and sign up. Verification takes under a minute.

items.q: How do I find cooks near me?
items.a: Open the Discover tab and allow location access. You’ll see home cooks and private chefs in your area, with availability shown on each profile.
Yes. Tap Follow on any cook’s profile. You’ll see their daily specials, new menus and availability in your feed.
Cooks set their own delivery windows. Some use our delivery partners; others offer collection only. Each cook’s profile shows their delivery options before you order.

items.q: What if my order is wrong or late?
items.a: Open the app and tap Get help on your order to raise it in the resolution centre. Do it within 24 hours of the order being marked delivered, and add photos where you can. We review it with the cook and decide on a full refund, a partial refund or no refund, and tell you the reason either way.
Cards, bank transfer and local payment methods, depending on your country. You’ll see the options available to you at checkout.

items.q: How do I get a refund?
items.a: Raise the issue in the resolution centre within 24 hours of delivery, or cancel before a rider collects your order for an automatic full refund. Approved refunds go back to the payment method you used. Card and bank refunds typically take 3 to 5 business days; wallet refunds arrive immediately. Full details are in our Refund and Cancellation Policy.
Payments are processed by PCI DSS-compliant payment partners. FOODSbyme never stores your card details on its servers.

items.q: How do I apply to join as a cook?
items.a: Apply through the app. We review your application, check the food rules that apply where you cook, and help you set up your profile. The process usually takes 5–10 business days.

items.q: Do I get my own link and storefront?
items.a: Yes. Every cook gets a profile link they can share anywhere. Customers can browse your full menu, follow you and order directly from your page.

items.q: Can I bring my social media following?
items.a: Yes. Connect your Instagram or TikTok during onboarding so your followers can find you on FOODS.

items.q: How and when do I get paid?
items.a: Request a payout any time from the Earnings section of the app once your bank account is verified. Standard transfers reach your account within 24 hours. Payouts are held while an order of yours is in dispute and released once it is settled.
A small platform fee per order, with no upfront costs and no monthly subscription. Full fee details are shared during onboarding.

items.q: How do I book a private chef?
items.a: Browse verified private chefs, check their availability and book directly in the app. Chefs take home dinners, birthdays, corporate events and weddings.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: We recommend at least 5 days ahead for events. Popular chefs are often booked weeks in advance.

items.q: What happens if a chef cancels my booking?
items.a: You’re fully refunded, and our team helps you find another chef for your event at no extra cost. Card and bank refunds typically take 3 to 5 business days to reach you.

support.stillBody: Our support team works Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00 UTC+1, and usually replies within a few hours.

dataDeletion.title: Request data deletion
dataDeletion.intro: To delete all personal data FOODSbyme holds about you, email {email} with the subject line “Data Deletion Request” and include the email address linked to your account. We permanently delete your data within 30 days and send you a confirmation.
dataDeletion.facebookBody: If you signed in or connected your account through Facebook, you can also start deletion from Facebook Settings, under Apps and Websites. Remove FOODSbyme and we receive and process your deletion request automatically.
what: Creator profile, menu items and earnings history
dataDeletion.retention: Some transaction records may be kept for longer where tax or financial law requires it. Our Privacy Policy explains this.
